results.paper: Geometric Signatures of Switching Behavior in Mechanobiology
results.quote: We discover geometric signatures of catch-slip and pathway switching behavior in the form of singularities in the flow field that describes force-induced deformation of minimum and saddle points. These singularities, which we call “switch points”, can be viewed as the basic building blocks of force-induced switching behavior in two dimensional systems.
